pins.title: Recovery Gifts for the Person Who Has Everything: Sleep, Soreness, or Stress?
pins.subtitle: Match the gift to what they mention
pins.description: Hard to shop for? Start with what they keep mentioning. Trouble winding down points toward magnesium, weighted products, or sleep trackers. Soreness points toward massage tools, red light therapy, or heat and cold recovery. Feeling run down points toward weighted products, sauna blankets, or readiness wearables. None of these are medical devices, and results vary. Not medical advice. #recoverygifts #sleepgifts #giftguide #hardtoshopfor #wellnessgifts

pins.title: Recovery Gift Upgrades: What to Buy Someone Who Already Owns the Basics
pins.subtitle: 4 comparisons before a second purchase
pins.description: Already gave the weighted blanket or massage tool? The better gift may be the next step, not a duplicate. Our guide points to four comparisons: sauna blanket vs home sauna, cold plunge vs sauna blanket, massage gun vs compression boots, and Oura Ring vs WHOOP. The pricier option isn't automatically the better gift. Not medical advice. #recoverygifts #giftguide #homerecovery #wellnessgifts #giftideas
